title: Minimum Operations to Make Binary Palindrome
summary: Given an integer array nums, for each element, determine the minimum operations needed to convert it into a binary palindrome.
statement: Given an integer array nums, for each element, determine the minimum operations needed to convert it into a binary palindrome. Operations include incrementing or decrementing the element by one.
constraints: nums contains up to 5,000 values between one and 5,000.
One operation increments or decrements one value by one.
For every input value, return its minimum distance to a nonnegative integer with palindromic binary representation.
hints: Changing by ±1 makes the cost exactly numeric distance to the target set.
Precompute all binary palindromes through the next all-ones bound above 5,000 and sort them.
Binary-search each value and compare the neighboring palindrome on each side.
In a sorted target set the nearest member must be the insertion successor or predecessor.
editorial: In a sorted target set the nearest member must be the insertion successor or predecessor.

tests.explanation: Binary one is already palindromic, while two and four are each one step from binary 11.
Nearest distances to binary palindromes are one, zero, and three.
